name: How much design flexibility do I have with ground-up construction?

mainEntity.name: How much design flexibility do I have with ground-up construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ground-up projects offer high flexibility in layout, structure, and systems, constrained mainly by site conditions, codes, and budget, allowing you to tailor the home closely to how you live. rsvc+2
